user.title: LYNNAI Hub
user.description: Enter the hub's address. Hubs found on your network: {found}

data_description.host: IP address of the hub (the one you open the admin page on).
data_description.port: Leave at 8484 unless you changed it.

pair.title: Pair with the hub
pair.description: Press the hub's button briefly (do not hold it), then submit within three minutes. The hub at {host} only accepts a new connection during that time.

error.denied: The hub rejected the connection. Press its button briefly and submit again within three minutes.
error.busy: The hub already serves two clients. Disconnect one (for example an unused SmartThings LAN driver) and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the hub. Check the address and that this machine is on the same network.
error.wrong_hub: A different hub answered at this address.

abort.already_configured: This hub is already set up.
abort.not_lynnai_hub: The device that answered is not a LYNNAI hub.

auto_fallback.name: Standalone while the cloud is unreachable
